LanguageData.SE_Settings_Intro: Select a serum to tune its effects. Each formula has independent settings; vanilla serums are unchanged.
LanguageData.SE_Settings_ResetConfirm: Restore every serum to its original balance? Your custom values will be removed.
LanguageData.SE_Settings_DurationHelp: One day is 24 in-game hours. Duration changes apply to future doses. Existing effect and coma timers keep their remaining time.
LanguageData.SE_Settings_DamageHelp: Damage-type multiplier. 1 is unchanged, 0.5 halves damage, 2 doubles it. This multiplies with the serum's overall incoming damage factor.
LanguageData.SE_Settings_CapHelp: Capacity ceiling, in percent. Raising consciousness above the coma threshold can let the pawn wake while the serum is still working.
LanguageData.SE_Settings_Draft: FORMULA EDITOR / Changes are saved only when applied
LanguageData.SE_Settings_ApplyHelp: Applies globally to this installation and all saves. Effect values update existing users; duration affects new doses. Cancel discards this draft. Categories follow the original formula.
LanguageData.SE_Settings_Invalid: Enter a valid number within the slider range before applying. Use a decimal point for fractions.
